patterns.context: Multiple test failures with similar symptoms suggest shared infrastructure cause

Diagnostic Efficiency: 529x faster than full suite (5.12s targeted)

patterns.name: Environment-First Diagnostic Strategy
patterns.context: Before investigating business logic, validate configuration and environment state
priority_order: 1. Environment Variables (check for empty strings, overrides)

anti_pattern.cost: 6 hours refactoring when 5-minute env check would suffice

why_this_matters: Leap 9 Case Study: Environment fix (1 hour) vs. business logic refactor (6 hours)
Blast Radius: Environment fixes have minimal risk (3-line removal vs. 300-line refactor)
Reversibility: Environment changes easily rollback (git revert vs. complex merge)

checklist: Check environment variables BEFORE business logic
Look for empty string overrides ('' is different from None)
Validate entry points for hardcoded config
Run targeted tests (not full suite) for fast feedback

patterns.name: API Drift Prevention via Schema Validation
patterns.context: API evolution without test fixture updates leads to test maintenance debt
patterns.root_cause: API evolution (SkillVector, create_agent_context) without test fixture updates

solution.auto_generate_fixtures: Derive test fixtures from Pydantic model schemas
solution.pre_commit_hook: Validate test fixtures match production schemas
solution.adr_documentation: ADR-033: Test Maintenance for API Changes

prevention_mechanism.enforcement: Pre-commit hook blocks commits if fixtures stale

implementation_example.fix: Auto-generate from Pydantic schema to prevent manual drift

expected_impact.future_prevention: Zero API drift test failures (pre-commit enforcement)
expected_impact.roi: High (one-time 5 hour investment prevents recurring 5 hour fixes)
